title: Seyyed
content: I was in the middle of a large, dry plain. The ground was cracked. Ahead and slightly to the right, there was a short mountain. There was fog to the left side of the mountain, yet the view was endless. Behind me, there was nothing. A man with a green shawl and a luminous face approached from ahead and slightly to the right. He put his hand on my chest and said, "Go back. You still have time."

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, While under general anesthesia, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I'm not sure. I am now 34 years old, but I think it hasn't changed
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain, In that state, I saw a strange light. I saw it shining on the ground.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: Some unfamiliar and strange place, It was strange and weird there. I felt that it wasn't where we live.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I believed in the messengers of God (prophets and Imams) and I met one of them.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Uncertain, I try to keep peace and I stand behind the weak. Everyone can count on me.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I saw a man with a green robe and a brilliant face that was not specific. It was light instead of a face. He said, "Go back, you still have a chance."
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, Yes, it was definitely a prophet or an imam. I sensed this subject, but I did not see their face. There was light in place of a face.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I was told to go back. They made me aware of the fact that I had been taken there.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I became calmer. I was very anxious at first.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: That land and that vision, and the illuminated atmosphere.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, Because I remember it completely.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have a friend named Farid. One year after my experience, I almost had another collision and was in a coma for one month. After he recovered, years later, he described what he had seen. He described the exact place I was in, down to the details. The difference was that he was facing that mountain, willing to go towards the truth. A man dressed in black was sitting and leaning his staff on the ground. I was terrified of that man. He described how after a while, he would run away from that man and then regain consciousness there.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I gave a complete explanation.
